name: EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin
summary: Compound-engineering plugin for Codex and other coding agents that traces stable requirement IDs through implementation units, requires per-unit verification evidence, applies eligible review fixes in `/lfg`, and writes solved problems to `docs/solutions/` as grounding for later planning.
evidence: Ships a native Codex plugin manifest and self-contained Codex App and CLI installation path, with Codex-specific invocation, goal-mode, conversion, and development-install behavior covered by repository tests.
Uses one readiness-based plan artifact whose stable requirement, acceptance-example, technical-decision, and implementation-unit IDs carry product intent into implementation packets.

Implementation-ready plans require a Product Contract, Planning Contract, independently executable implementation units, a repository-specific Verification Contract, and global and per-unit Definition of Done criteria.

The implementation loop chooses and records evidence per behavior-bearing unit, checks integration effects beyond unit tests, and blocks completion when verification evidence or a deliberate replacement-verification exception is missing.

The autonomous lfg pipeline requires a reviewed plan before work, routes review findings through verified fixes or durable residual records, runs browser checks when applicable, and watches PR feedback and CI before completing.
Solved problems are written to the project learning corpus and reused as grounding by later brainstorming and planning cycles.
